## History

Julia Bell attended school alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md). She enthusiastically welcomed [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back to school when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returned in October. Later, when the new teacher Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) took over, Julia became one of the pupils participating in Miss Stacy's planned [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert to raise money for a schoolhouse flag.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--julia-bell.md)

Julia Bell and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) are [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) schoolmates who share a friendly relationship. They enjoy exchanging gifts and sharing poetry with one another as peers in the same classroom.
